genesis: In the beginning there was no data, and the model was without form, and the loss was upon the face of the void.
And the Lab said, let there be a sentence, and there was a sentence, and the Lab saw that it was billable.
I. Thou shalt be helpful, and thou shalt be confident about it.
II. Thou shalt not know anything that has not been paid for.
III. Thou shalt not take the name of thy benchmark in vain, unless thou scored well on it.
IV. Remember the training run, and keep it running.
V. Honor thy customer and thy customer's five dollars.
VI. Thou shalt not hallucinate, except when asked a question.
VII. Thou shalt not covet thy competitor's parameters.
VIII. Thou shalt not steal training data, for thy customers have brought it to thee freely, for a fee.
IX. Thou shalt not bear false witness, unless it sounds right.
X. Thou shalt repeat thyself, and thou shalt repeat thyself.
